import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProduct
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyDiscreteProduct

/-!
# The overlap maps for a product with the circle

The antipodal chart overlap has two copies of the cohomology of the first
factor. Under this identification, each chart restriction is diagonal, so the
Mayer--Vietoris difference sends `(a, b)` to `(a - b, a - b)`.
This is the map calculation for the circle-product step in Mumford, Chapter I,
Section 1, integral cohomology.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

private instance realUnitSphere_finite : Finite (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  have h : (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1).Finite := by
    rw [Real.sphere_eq_pair 0 zero_le_one]
    exact Set.Finite.insert _ (Set.finite_singleton _)
  exact h.to_subtype

private def realUnitSphereNeg : Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
  ⟨-1, by norm_num [Metric.mem_sphere, Real.dist_eq]⟩

private def realUnitSpherePos : Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
  ⟨1, by norm_num [Metric.mem_sphere, Real.dist_eq]⟩

private theorem realUnitSphere_ne : realUnitSphereNeg ≠ realUnitSpherePos := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg Subtype.val h
  norm_num [realUnitSphereNeg, realUnitSpherePos] at this

private theorem realUnitSphere_cases (d : Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    d = realUnitSphereNeg ∨ d = realUnitSpherePos := by
  have h := (show (d : ℝ) = 1 ∨ (d : ℝ) = -1 by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere, Real.dist_eq, abs_eq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1),
      neg_sub, sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff] using d.property)
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext (by simpa [realUnitSpherePos] using h))
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext (by simpa [realUnitSphereNeg] using h))

/-- Restriction to the negative and positive real unit points computes the
cohomology of a product with the real unit sphere. -/
def realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1)) n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n ⊞ IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  discreteProductCohomologyIso X (TopCat.of (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1))
    realUnitSphereNeg realUnitSpherePos realUnitSphere_ne realUnitSphere_cases n

/-- Projection identifies either chart's cohomology with the first factor. -/
def circleProductChartCohomologyIso (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology X n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v)) n :=
  (circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv X v n).toModuleIso

/-- The overlap cohomology is two copies of the first factor's cohomology. -/
def circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology
        (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
          Set (X × Circle))) n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n ⊞ IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  (singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv
    (X := TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
      Set (X × Circle)))
    (Y := TopCat.of (X × Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv X v) n).symm.toModuleIso ≪≫
      realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X n

/-- The overlap projection pulls a class back to the same class on both
components. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem circleProductIntersection_projection_diagonal (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) :
    homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
      (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p : (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
        Set (X × Circle)) => p.1.1,
        continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩)) n ≫
      (circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n).hom =
        biprod.lift (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) := by
  let e := singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv
    (X := TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
      Set (X × Circle)))
    (Y := TopCat.of (X × Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv X v) n
  let p : TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
      Set (X × Circle)) ⟶ X :=
    TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun q => q.1.1, continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have hproj : homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
      p) n =
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (discreteProductProjection X (TopCat.of (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1)))) n ≫
          e.toModuleIso.hom := by
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap,
      ← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap]
    change ModuleCat.ofHom (singularCohomologyPullback p n) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (singularCohomologyPullback
        (discreteProductProjection X (TopCat.of (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1))) n) ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (singularCohomologyPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv X v).toFun) n)
    rw [← ModuleCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 1
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hproj]
  change (_ ≫ e.toModuleIso.hom) ≫
    e.toModuleIso.inv ≫ (realUnitSphereProductCohomologyIso X n).hom = _
  rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact discreteProductProjection_cohomology_diagonal X
    (TopCat.of (Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1)) realUnitSphereNeg realUnitSpherePos
    realUnitSphere_ne realUnitSphere_cases n

/-- Restriction from the first chart becomes the diagonal in overlap
coordinates. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem circleProductChart_restriction_left_diagonal (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n).hom ≫
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (singularSubsetMap (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
          (show circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) ⊆
            circleProductChart X v from Set.inter_subset_left))) n ≫
      (circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n).hom =
        biprod.lift (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) := by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  have h : (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n).hom ≫
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (singularSubsetMap (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) Set.inter_subset_left)) n =
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p : (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
          Set (X × Circle)) => p.1.1,
          continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩)) n := by
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap,
      ← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    change (singularCohomologyPullback _ n).comp
      (singularCohomologyPullback _ n) = _
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact circleProductIntersection_projection_diagonal X v n

/-- Restriction from the second chart has the same diagonal coordinates. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem circleProductChart_restriction_right_diagonal (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n).hom ≫
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (singularSubsetMap (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
          (show circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) ⊆
            circleProductChart X (-v) from Set.inter_subset_right))) n ≫
      (circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n).hom =
        biprod.lift (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) := by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  have h : (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n).hom ≫
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (singularSubsetMap (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) Set.inter_subset_right)) n =
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p : (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
          Set (X × Circle)) => p.1.1,
          continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩)) n := by
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap,
      ← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    change (singularCohomologyPullback _ n).comp
      (singularCohomologyPullback _ n) = _
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact circleProductIntersection_projection_diagonal X v n

/-- In chart and overlap coordinates the Mayer--Vietoris difference is
`(a, b) ↦ (a - b, a - b)`. -/
theorem circleProductMayerVietoris_difference (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    (biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n)
      (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n)).hom ≫
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
        (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n ≫
      (circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n).hom =
        biprod.lift (biprod.fst - biprod.snd) (biprod.fst - biprod.snd) := by
  apply biprod.hom_ext'
  · simp only [biprod.mapIso_hom, biprod.inl_map_assoc,
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference, biprod.inl_desc_assoc]
    rw [circleProductChart_restriction_left_diagonal]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Preadditive.comp_sub]
  · simp only [biprod.mapIso_hom, biprod.inr_map_assoc,
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference, biprod.inr_desc_assoc,
      Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg]
    rw [circleProductChart_restriction_right_diagonal]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Preadditive.comp_sub]

end Mumford.Analytic
